description: Disconnect a connected account. The connection is REMOVED: the account stops publishing straight away, frees a slot against the plan's account limit, disappears from chirpie_list_accounts, and calling this again with the same id answers 404. Reconnecting it means the user authorizing Chirpie on that platform again, whereas chirpie_deactivate_account keeps the connection so the account can come back later without reauthorizing. CANCELS the account's scheduled posts: every post queued against it is cancelled and its monthly quota returned, and `canceled_posts` in the response says how many. They are NOT restored. Posts the account already published keep their history, but stop reporting its handle and come back with `account_id: null`. `scheduled_posts` in chirpie_list_accounts says beforehand how many posts this would cancel. Cannot be undone.
name: chirpie_disconnect_account
title: Disconnect an account
